# SPsoft

> > SPsoft is a healthcare and FMCG software development company specializing in AI-powered clinical solutions, EHR/EMR systems, and HIPAA-compliant healthcare applications.

SPsoft delivers custom healthcare software with deep expertise in GenAI, clinical workflows, medical coding automation, and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, FDA, HL7/FHIR). The company focuses on transforming healthcare delivery through AI agents, clinical decision support, and enterprise healthcare platforms.

## Key Topics

- GenAI & LLMs
- Healthcare AI Solutions
- EHR/EMR Development
- Clinical Documentation
- Voice AI Agents
- Medical Coding Automation (ICD-10/CPT)
- RAG Systems
- HIPAA Compliance
- HL7/FHIR Integration
- Telehealth Software
- Clinical Decision Support
- Medical Device Software (SaMD)
- Patient Engagement
- Revenue Cycle Management
- FDA/ISO Compliance

## Healthcare AI Solutions

- [Healthcare AI Solutions & Services](https://spsoft.com/healthcare-ai-solutions-services): Healthcare AI solutions with GenAI, RAG, medical coding automation, ICD-10/CPT
- [Voice AI Agents For Healthcare](https://spsoft.com/voice-ai-agents-for-healthcare): Voice AI agents for patient intake, appointment management, mental health support
- [AI Medical Assistant For Clinicians](https://spsoft.com/ai-medical-assistant-for-clinicians): AI medical assistant for clinical documentation, workflow optimization, patient triage
- [Clinical Notes AI Solution](https://spsoft.com/clinical-notes-ai-solution): Clinical notes AI for digitization, EHR analysis, HIPAA compliance, revenue cycle
